user_query: trass gmail and stories with terms international mgm shipbob ca uk au avask within last 2 months

intent.goal: find emails and stories containing international business terms

generated_query:
SELECT DISTINCT
    u.page_id,
    u.workspace,
    u.database_name,
    u.title,
    u.created_time,
    COALESCE(g.subject, '') as subject,
    COALESCE(g.sender_name, '') as sender_name,
    COALESCE(g.sender_email, '') as sender_email
FROM unified_content u
LEFT JOIN gmail_content g ON u.page_id = g.page_id
LEFT JOIN generic_content gc ON u.page_id = gc.page_id
WHERE u.workspace IN ('trass')
AND u.database_name IN ('gmail', 'stories')
AND (
    u.created_time >= datetime('now', '-2 months')
    OR g.email_date >= datetime('now', '-2 months')
)
AND (
    LOWER(COALESCE(g.subject, '')) LIKE '%international%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(g.subject, '')) LIKE '%mgm%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(g.subject, '')) LIKE '%shipbob%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(g.subject, '')) LIKE '%ca%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(g.subject, '')) LIKE '%uk%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(g.subject, '')) LIKE '%au%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(g.subject, '')) LIKE '%avask%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(g.message_content, '')) LIKE '%international%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(g.message_content, '')) LIKE '%mgm%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(g.message_content, '')) LIKE '%shipbob%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(g.message_content, '')) LIKE '%ca%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(g.message_content, '')) LIKE '%uk%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(g.message_content, '')) LIKE '%au%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(g.message_content, '')) LIKE '%avask%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(gc.metadata, '')) LIKE '%international%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(gc.metadata, '')) LIKE '%mgm%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(gc.metadata, '')) LIKE '%shipbob%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(gc.metadata, '')) LIKE '%ca%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(gc.metadata, '')) LIKE '%uk%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(gc.metadata, '')) LIKE '%au%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(gc.metadata, '')) LIKE '%avask%'
)
ORDER BY u.created_time DESC
LIMIT 1200;
